proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H X hH hperp hX
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hH
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hX
  have e : A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C t = (A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C s) + (s - t) • (C -ᵥ B) := by
    rw [← vsub_add_vsub_cancel A (AffineMap.lineMap B C s) (AffineMap.lineMap B C t)]
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_vadd_cancel_right, sub_smul]
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A, e]
  refine abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' ?_ (by positivity) |>.2
  rw [norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, hperp]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖(s - t) • (C -ᵥ B)‖]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H X : P), H ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → X ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → dist A H ≤ dist A X
